proposed_facts.reason: Canonical Turn predicate uses input.lstick[0].x and an inclusive comparison. The owned wrapper conditionally enters and returns true; HammerWait IASA checks ftCo_800C55CC afterward only if this check fails. Document and proposal agree.

Canonical animation guard, decrement, suppression branch and terminal comparison support the qualified facing-reversal mapping. HammerWait entry and the actual callback table confirm the action association. Numerical qualifications avoid an unconditional half-turn guarantee; runtime invariants and exceptional execution remain deferred.

The wrapper forwards unconditionally. The immediate helper uses the strict above-walk-speed comparison, scales friction conditionally and calls friction before movement. Neither body explicitly transitions motion; the proposal correctly declines a universal transitive guarantee.

Owned control flow supports the nonzero animation guard, optional yaw, terminal facing reversal and ungated jump polling. Independently read jump forwarding and HammerKneeBend entry establish the accepted-input route without requiring compiled timer-overlay equivalence.
